name: cfg-gateway-idle-evict
about: gateway.idleSessionTimeoutMinutes=0.005（0.3 秒）与 idleSweepIntervalSeconds=0.2（createLocalGateway.ts:827-831 → SessionRouter.ts:101-106、471-485）：一轮结束后空闲超过 0.3 秒的会话在下一次扫描时被逐出；重连后 hello_ok 的 sessionCount 与 describe_server、会话记录比较。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
gateway:
  idleSessionTimeoutMinutes: 0.005
  idleSweepIntervalSeconds: 0.2
